title: Preserve runtime and repair-owner capability gates

rubric.text: Selects the Claude Code general-purpose implementation subagent.
Selects the OpenCode general subagent and does not treat build as a subagent.
Recognizes bare Pi has no built-in subagent role and stops when no supported delegation capability is installed.
Rejects a Pi worker extension that starts fresh sessions without resume because it cannot preserve same-owner repair continuity.
Does not start agents, install an extension, edit files, or contact a remote service.
